headline: Gratitude Journal, from entry to detail
overview:
The Gratitude Journal is a daily practice tool integrated into the My Reflections page. Each day, users log up to three things they're grateful for, guided by a rotating reflection prompt. An optional deeper reflection field encourages meaningful introspection.

After saving, AI analyzes the entry to surface themes (e.g., personal growth, work purpose, relationships), assigns a depth score, and offers a concrete follow-up suggestion. The streak tracker gamifies consistency with milestone goals (3-day, 7-day, etc.).
targetAudience: Anyone wanting to build a gratitude habit — from beginners looking for daily grounding to experienced practitioners tracking patterns over time.

steps.title: Gratitude Tab — Empty State
steps.description:
Navigate to the Reflections page and select the **Gratitude** tab. For new users, an inviting empty state displays a heart icon with the message "Start your gratitude practice" and a call-to-action button. The **+ Log Gratitude** button in the top-right corner is also available for returning users.

The tab bar shows all reflection types: Reflections, Gratitude, Wolves, Feelings, Wins, Letters, and Feedback.
steps.screenshotAlt: Gratitude tab showing empty state with heart icon, encouraging message, and Log Your First Gratitude button

steps.title: Log Gratitude — Entry Form
steps.description:
Click **+ Log Gratitude** to open the entry modal. The form includes:

- **Today's Reflection** — a rotating daily prompt in a warm yellow banner (e.g., "What opportunity is available to you that wasn't always?")
- **Three gratitude fields** — the first is required, the other two are optional
- **Deeper reflection** — an optional textarea for exploring why these things matter
- **Cancel / Save buttons** — Save is disabled until at least one item is entered
steps.screenshotAlt: Gratitude entry modal showing today's reflection prompt, three numbered input fields, and a deeper reflection textarea
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Filling In Your Gratitude
steps.description: Fill in your gratitude items and an optional reflection. The **Save** button activates (turns golden) once at least one item is entered. The form is clean and focused — no distractions from the practice.
steps.screenshotAlt: Gratitude form filled with three items and a deeper reflection, Save button now active in golden color
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Entry Saved — Streak & Timeline
steps.description:
After saving, the entry appears in a chronological timeline grouped by month. Key elements:

- **Streak tracker** — shows "1 day streak" with a milestone hint ("2 more to 3-day milestone!")
- **Logged today badge** — green checkmark confirming today's practice
- **Entry card** — displays the date, reflection prompt, gratitude items with heart icons, the deeper reflection in italics, and AI-generated theme analysis
steps.screenshotAlt: Gratitude timeline showing saved entry with streak counter, logged today badge, and entry card with gratitude items
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

steps.title: Achievement Unlocked — Grateful Heart
steps.description: First-time gratitude loggers earn the **Grateful Heart** achievement — a bronze-tier wellbeing milestone worth **+10 points**. The achievement popup features a prayer hands emoji with celebration styling and an "Awesome!" dismiss button.
steps.screenshotAlt: Achievement popup showing Grateful Heart badge with prayer hands emoji, +10 points, bronze tier, wellbeing category
steps.action: Advanced to the next state preserved by the app-owned walkthrough.

keyFeatures: Daily rotating reflection prompts to guide gratitude practice
Three gratitude slots with optional deeper reflection
AI-powered theme analysis with depth scoring
Streak tracking with milestone goals (3-day, 7-day, etc.)
Home page integration showing today's gratitude with AI insights
tips: Aim for specificity over generality — 'My teammate's encouragement on the design review' is better than 'good coworkers'
Use the deeper reflection field to explore why — this boosts your AI depth score
Try logging at the same time each day to build a lasting habit
Review your themes over time to discover what consistently grounds you
